base_rich.content:
Settings page:

<!--rich:image:web:00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000009-->

Steps:

**Make Google the default search engine in Edge**

1. Open Settings from the ... menu
2. Choose Privacy, search, and services
3. Open Address bar and search
4. Pick Google under Search engine used in the address bar — Google appears only after you have searched with it once. [support.example](https://support.example/edge-search)

Result:

**Figure:** Low shadows remove the contact shadow, so the car looks like it floats.

- Shadows: High — Car with a soft contact shadow under the chassis ([screens1.example](https://screens1.example/graphics))
- Shadows: Low — Same car with no contact shadow ([screens2.example](https://screens2.example/graphics))

<!--rich:figure:242d1a004a09969dee7f9860-->
